2609.34661.title: Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents
2609.34661.paper_summary: Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path. Because a partial program cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space of interdependent choices, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program reasoning. Puzzles are synthesized from scratch via semantic reification, so fresh puzzles of controllable complexity can be generated on demand, each with a witness that guarantees solvability. We evaluate five frontier models on 300 puzzles through a coding agent free to use any tool within a fixed budget. Small puzzles already challenge open-weight models, whereas even proprietary models solve only about half of the large ones. Codoku thus offers a renewable testbed for program reasoning that can keep pace with rapidly improving coding agents. GitHub: https://github.com/connglli/Codoku.
2609.34661.paper_summary_zh: 現有的程式推理基準要求大型語言模型預測程式在給定輸入下的行為。<lb/>編碼代理打破了這些基準所依賴的兩個假設：代理可以通過執行程式來獲得答案，而不是進行推理，並且來自現有程式的固定任務集越來越容易受到污染，但更新成本高昂。<lb/>我們介紹了Codoku（程式數獨），這是一個可再生的基準，解決者在部分程式中填寫類型化的單元格，以滿足全局靜態和動態約束，例如規定的控制流圖和執行路徑。<lb/>由於部分程式無法執行，並且在指互依賴選擇的指數級大空間中有效填充稀疏，因此工具使用或枚舉都無法替代程式推理。<lb/>謎題是通過語義實體化從零開始合成的，因此可以根據需求生成可控複雜度的新謎題，每個謎題都有一個證人以保證可解性。<lb/>我們通過一個編碼代理在300個謎題上評估了五個前沿模型，該代理可以在固定預算內自由使用任何工具。<lb/>小謎題已經對開放權重模型構成挑戰，而即使是專有模型也僅解決了大約一半的大謎題。<lb/>因此，Codoku提供了一個可再生的程式推理測試平台，可以跟上快速改進的編碼代理的步伐。<lb/>GitHub: https://github.com/connglli/Codoku.
